nodes.description: address public owner; set to msg.sender in constructor and checked by onlyOwner modifier
address public founder; set to msg.sender in FOOD constructor and used in whenNotPaused to bypass pause
bool public paused; global transfer stop flag toggled by pause/unpause
uint256 public totalSupply; minted in constructor and reduced by burnTokens
mapping(address => uint256) balances; core ledger of token ownership
mapping(address => mapping(address => uint256)) allowed; ERC20 allowance ledger
mapping(address => uint256) frozenTokenBalances; tokens locked by owner via freezeTokens
msg.sender; attacker-controlled caller used for authorization and balance accounting
transfer(address _to, uint256 _value) public returns (bool); moves tokens from msg.sender
transferFrom(address _from, address _to, uint256 _value) public; spends allowance of msg.sender
approve(address _spender, uint256 _value) public returns (bool); sets allowance
freezeTokens(address _owner, uint256 _value) public onlyOwner; locks user tokens
unfreezeTokens(address _owner, uint256 _value) public onlyOwner; unlocks user tokens
burnTokens(uint256 _tokens) public onlyOwner; destroys owner tokens and reduces totalSupply
destroy(address payable _benefitiary) external onlyOwner; selfdestructs the contract
setFrozenBalance(address _owner, uint256 _newValue) internal; writes frozenTokenBalances
balanceOf(address _owner) view public; returns total minus frozen balance
getFrozenBalance(address _owner) view public; returns frozenTokenBalances[_owner]
transferOwnership(address newOwner) public onlyOwner; changes owner
pause() public onlyOwner whenNotPaused; sets paused = true
unpause() public onlyOwner whenPaused; sets paused = false
selfdestruct(_benefitiary) in destroy; irreversible destruction of contract and fund transfer
SafeMath sub/add arithmetic on balances and totalSupply in transfer/transferFrom/burnTokens/freezeTokens/unfreezeTokens
_to: destination address of transfer/transferFrom
_value: amount of tokens transferred or approved
_from: source address in transferFrom
_spender: allowance beneficiary in approve
_owner: address whose tokens are frozen/unfrozen or queried
_benefitiary: payable receiver of selfdestruct funds
_tokens: amount of tokens to burn
newOwner: new owner address in transferOwnership
oldFrozenBalance: cached frozen balance before add/sub
newFrozenBalance: computed frozen balance written back

edges.reason: msg.sender is the debited account and Transfer emitter in transfer
msg.sender indexes allowed[_from][msg.sender] allowance spend in transferFrom
msg.sender owns the allowance being set in approve
burnTokens reads balanceOf(msg.sender) and burns that balance
destroy is gated by onlyOwner which compares msg.sender with owner
freezeTokens is gated by onlyOwner modifier
unfreezeTokens is gated by onlyOwner modifier
burnTokens is gated by onlyOwner modifier
constructor assigns owner = msg.sender; onlyOwner compares msg.sender == owner
founder is set to msg.sender and used in whenNotPaused to bypass the pause
transfer writes balances[msg.sender] and balances[_to]
transferFrom decrements allowed[_from][msg.sender]
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][_spender]
freezeTokens increases frozenTokenBalances[_owner]
unfreezeTokens decreases frozenTokenBalances[_owner]
freezeTokens calls setFrozenBalance to store the new value
unfreezeTokens calls setFrozenBalance to store the new value
burnTokens subtracts _tokens from totalSupply
burnTokens subtracts _tokens from balances[msg.sender]
transfer performs SafeMath sub/add on balances
freezeTokens adds _value to the frozen balance
unfreezeTokens subtracts _value from the frozen balance
destroy executes selfdestruct, transferring all funds
_benefitiary address is the recipient of the selfdestruct transfer
_to is the credited destination in transfer
_value is the amount debited/credited in transfer
_from is the debited account in transferFrom
_to is the credited destination in transferFrom
_value is the amount moved in transferFrom
_spender is the allowance beneficiary in approve
_owner is the account whose tokens are frozen
_owner is the account whose tokens are unfrozen
_owner indexes balances/frozenTokenBalances in balanceOf
_tokens is the burned amount in burnTokens
newOwner becomes owner, an access-control critical value; newOwner must be non-zero
oldFrozenBalance is read then increased in freezeTokens
oldFrozenBalance is read then decreased in unfreezeTokens
newFrozenBalance is written through setFrozenBalance
pause sets paused = true
unpause sets paused = false
paused state controls transfer execution through whenNotPaused
paused state controls transferFrom execution through whenNotPaused
balanceOf subtracts frozenTokenBalances from the total balance
getFrozenBalance reads frozenTokenBalances[_owner]
freezeTokens reads the frozen balance via getFrozenBalance
unfreezeTokens reads the frozen balance via getFrozenBalance

normalization_plan.reason: _to is purely the destination parameter of transfer and has no independent semantics
_value is the amount parameter consumed by transfer and its SafeMath operations
_from is only the source parameter of transferFrom
_spender is only the allowance target parameter of approve
_owner is the token holder parameter used by the freeze path
_benefitiary is the value flowing into the selfdestruct unsafe operation
_tokens is the burn amount parameter consumed by burnTokens
newOwner is the access-control value assigned by transferOwnership
oldFrozenBalance is a transient local only used inside the freeze computation
newFrozenBalance is a transient local written through setFrozenBalance
